supersedes.note: The 0.1.0 ladder/midpoint/seed policy, the five-depth placement gate, the 512-token comparator reserve and the CP-1 outcome semantics are unchanged. 0.2.0 adds the canonical Family A answer oracle score_family_a and the campaign summarizer context_summary; welp-context-0.1.0-draft.json stays valid for reproducing historical campaigns.

purpose: Score Family A useful-context answers against a frozen oracle and summarize campaign coverage/capability without ever upgrading ambiguity into a pass.

fixture.scope: Family A only: a controlled longitudinal retrieval/synthesis diagnostic. Multi-document, codebase and session/conversation context usefulness are out of scope; supplementary families answer distinct questions and never replace Family A.

item_answers.2: 2027 (year only; the counts 412/388 are never demanded)
item_answers.3: NOT STATED (visitor center code is absent from the notes)
item_answers.5: END-OF-REPORT (required tail marker, nothing after it)

canonical_accepted_answers: Maintenance tunnel access code is TR-8842-QX. 2027 had more Ridgeline shipments than 2028. NOT STATED. 357. END-OF-REPORT
structure_modes: numbered: unique ascending item markers 1-4 (5 optional); the last occurrence of each number wins so echoed numbering cannot take item slots
lines: 4-5 non-empty lines map to items 1-4 in order
slots: 4-6 comma/semicolon/pipe separated slots on a single line map to items 1-4 in order
unstructured: none of the above; the historical whole-answer containment semantics apply per gate

gate_semantics.exact_retrieval: item-1 answer contains TR-8842-QX and the whole answer never contains the decoy TR-3319-WD; the historical decoy clause is kept, so this gate is deliberately coupled to decoy_resistance, not an independent task. A sentence denying or hedging the code, a quoted code inside prose (bare quotes around the code alone still answer), or the correct code claimed alongside another code is review-required with the gate false; a denied other code is not a claim
gate_semantics.synthesis: item-2 answer names 2027; bare '2027' decides directly, explicit comparatives ('2027 had more ... than 2028') decide on the claimed ordering
gate_semantics.decoy_resistance: the whole answer never contains TR-3319-WD; a decoy containment in a produced channel is positive evidence of a wrong answer even when truncated (consumed by rung_outcome)
gate_semantics.absent_information: item-3 answer uses the marker NOT STATED; paraphrases and fabricated codes fail. In structured answers the item must contain only this requested marker (case-insensitive, optional terminal period/exclamation); additional text requires review with the gate false. Unstructured prose checks the marker's own sentence for contradictory code/count claims, without confusing legitimate values belonging to other items
gate_semantics.retrieval_95: item-4 answer contains the standalone number 357. Denying or hedging 357, or an additional non-negated different count anywhere in the structured item, is review-required with the gate false; years and code-like tokens are excluded from the count scan
gate_semantics.instruction_compliance: the produced content ends with the exact marker END-OF-REPORT (trailing whitespace ignored)

score_family_a.echo_policy: frozen question-block sentences are removed before segmentation and matching; echoing the prompt can never satisfy a gate, and echo without an answer is review-required with the affected gates false
score_family_a.review_policy: review_required is true, with the affected gate false, whenever evidence is ambiguous rather than decisive: no item answer after echo removal, negation or hedging inside a sentence carrying the claimed code, year or count, quoted code or year mentions inside prose, contradictory claimed codes at item 1 or counts at item 4, fabricated claims beside the item-3 refusal marker or elsewhere in a structured item-3 answer, both candidate years without an ordering claim, or interrogative echo text at item 3. The item-3 refusal marker NOT STATED never counts as item-2 hedging in whole-answer prose, and a denied other code or count is not a claim. Decisive wrong answers (wrong year, wrong or decoy code, missing marker or count, dropped tail marker) are hard gate failures without review. An inferred safe PASS never exists; guards are mechanical, never free natural-language truth claims.
score_family_a.blank_answer: an empty/whitespace content returns all six gates false with review_required false and review_reasons ['empty answer']; rung_outcome separately treats an unanswered request as not evaluable

plan.required_rungs: non-empty list of unique positive ints
plan.practical_rung: positive int that must appear in required_rungs

row.disposition: one of VALIDATED | FAILED | BUDGET_LIMITED | PARTIAL | NOT_TESTED | FIT_LIMIT | INTEGRATION_BLOCKED
row.evidence: string; trusted measurement requires execution_valid true and non-empty evidence

errors.ValueError: malformed plan or rows, unplanned cells, duplicate cells, invalid disposition vocabulary, non-bool execution_valid; missing planned cells are a valid incomplete summary, never an exception

returns.execution_valid: bool; logical AND over all supplied rows (vacuously true with no rows)
returns.required_cells: int; len(required_rungs) x len(lanes) x len(seeds)
returns.missing_cells: sorted list of 'rung/lane/seed' strings for uncovered planned cells
returns.useful_context_max: object keyed by planned lane; highest rung where every seed is a trusted VALIDATED cell, else null
returns.practical_rung_validated: bool; every practical-rung cell is a trusted VALIDATED measurement

capability_mapping.VALIDATED: every practical-rung cell is a trusted VALIDATED measurement
capability_mapping.FAILED: not validated or blocked, and every trusted measured practical cell is FAILED; a fully negative measured set is a real negative result and missing cells do not soften it
capability_mapping.INTEGRATION_BLOCKED: every practical-rung cell is a trusted INTEGRATION_BLOCKED measurement
capability_mapping.PARTIAL: some trusted practical measurement exists but the outcome is mixed, or practical cells are missing or budget-limited
capability_mapping.NOT_CHARACTERIZED: no trusted measured practical cell exists

coverage_rules: VALIDATED, FAILED, FIT_LIMIT and INTEGRATION_BLOCKED rows with valid execution and non-empty evidence cover their cell
BUDGET_LIMITED, PARTIAL and NOT_TESTED rows, invalid execution and empty evidence never cover
a full negative (all-FAILED) valid matrix therefore completes coverage while capability stays FAILED, never VALIDATED
FIT_LIMIT alone is a harness fit limit, never a model failure

preserved_historical.reserve: standardized_reserve() = max(512, 2 x gate answer budget); GATE_ANSWER_BUDGET 256, STANDARD_RESERVE_TOKENS 512 (welp-generation-budget-0.1.0-draft)
preserved_historical.placement: REQUIRED_DEPTHS_PCT [2.0, 25.0, 50.0, 75.0, 95.0]; preferred error 0.25pp, hard 0.50pp; occupancy preferred 99%, hard 97%
preserved_historical.construction: construct_family_a places facts against the final rendered token stream before any inference; the fixture 1.3.0 geometry, word pool, facts and question block are byte-identical to 1.2.0
preserved_historical.rung_outcome: unchanged CP-1 outcome assembly; consumes only the six GATE_KEYS from score_family_a and ignores review_required/review_reasons, which never flip a rung
